bugs.error_message: CI ShellCheck SC2012 + Prettier formatting failures on PR #5
bugs.root_cause: New ai-sync code used `ls -d .../*/` pipes for directory counting (SC2012) and `ls -t *.json | head -1` for mtime sort (SC2012). Prettier also reformatted 2>/dev/null spacing and case statement layout.
bugs.fix: Replaced ls -d directory counts with `find -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d`. Added inline `# shellcheck disable=SC2012` for ls -t mtime sort. Ran `pnpm format` to apply Prettier fixes.
